# MenuPricer

> AI-powered menu pricing tool that helps restaurant owners, cafés, bakeries, food trucks, and caterers calculate the right selling price for any menu item — starting from just a dish name, no written recipe required.

MenuPricer estimates ingredient costs with AI, then calculates food cost percentage, gross margin, and a recommended price across three tiers (Budget, Standard, Premium). It also accounts for delivery platform commissions (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub). Free for up to 5 dishes; Pro plan is $9/month or $79/year for unlimited dishes, batch pricing, analytics, and PDF export.

## Core Tool

- [Homepage / AI Pricing Tool](https://www.aimenupricer.com/): Type a dish name, get AI-estimated ingredient costs and 3 pricing tiers in under a minute.
- [Pricing](https://www.aimenupricer.com/pricing): Free vs Pro plan details, including a feature comparison table.
- [About](https://www.aimenupricer.com/about): What MenuPricer is, who it's for, and how it works.
- [Editorial Policy](https://www.aimenupricer.com/editorial-policy): How statistics and benchmarks are sourced and reviewed.
- [Glossary](https://www.aimenupricer.com/glossary): Plain-language definitions for 31 restaurant pricing and food cost terms.
